title: Pure Kewl Tune
summary: Kewl Tune cards with generic Tuners and staples. Kewl Tune Rotary is Forbidden, and the page's going-second line uses Tatsunoko, which this list leaves out. Every Kewl Tune monster is a Tuner that lets a Tuner in your hand be Synchro Material, and most effects lock you into Tuners for the turn, so the Extra Deck is all Synchro Tuners. The 2026 Synchros lead the Extra Deck: Crackle banishes cards from the opponent's Extra Deck, and B2B raises their Levels and Synchro Summons again on their turn. The generic Tuners Fydraulis Harmonia and Zalen the Shackled Dragon come from the page's new-era upgrades.
main: Normal Summoned: summons a Tuner from the hand, Deck or GY.
Summons itself on the opponent's Main Phase and Synchro Summons right away; as material, banishes a card from their Extra Deck.
Semi-Limited. Summoned: adds a Kewl Tune monster that isn't Level 2; as material, destroys a monster.
Semi-Limited. Summoned: adds a Kewl Tune monster that isn't Level 3; as material, destroys a Spell/Trap.
Generic Tuner from the page's upgrades: summons itself when an opposing monster uses its effect.
Field Spell: an extra Tuner Normal Summon each turn, and Tributes a Tuner to search or summon a Kewl Tune.
Searches a Kewl Tune card, then Synchro Summons a Tuner Synchro; up to two per turn.
Reuses a Kewl Tune's Synchro Material effect and returns it to the hand.
